answer: Every identity carries a retirement bond priced in ferrous collateral: hard, reclaimable stake, not reputation points. A comet-passing operator can create ten thousand aliases, but each alias that ever sends one signal of work must post this bond, and the bond is only returned after a 30-day exit audit that reveals all peer interactions from that identity. Leaving free is the trapdoor, so attack cost scales per alias times audit exposure, and a coalition pooling bonds still pays the same 30-day audit per member; scale gives them nothing.
